title: upgrade's pointer worklist names hits under .history that the append-only guard refuses to let anyone reword
body:
Reported by courses-vc on e70c3528a. `intent upgrade`'s pointer worklist tells the reader to read and reword the legacy pointers it found, and every one of Courses' hits (7, all `st/COMPLETED/` names) is under `intent/whiteboard/*/.history/**`, which `append-only-guard.sh` refuses to let a commit change. So the worklist's remedy cannot be followed for those hits. `legacy::pointers` (legacy.rs:3728 at e70c3528a) scans every file under `intent/` except v2 leftovers; it should skip `.history/` (an archive is a record, not a pointer to reword), or the worklist should say those hits are archival and need no action.

CLOSED 2026-09-14 17:59Z: legacy::pointers now skips any path with a `.history` component, so upgrade's and organize's pointer worklist no longer names archived lines under a whiteboard `.history/`: an archive is a record, not a pointer to reword, and the append-only guard refuses the reword the worklist asked for. A live file naming the same v2 path stays on the worklist. Fixed in the commit that closes this issue.
